newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco to end kaolin output at Weipa.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco to end kaolin output at Weipa.

text.p: Aluminium and alumina producer Comalco Ltd said on Wednesday it would stop kaolin production at its Weipa mine in Queensland under a restructuring plan which will incur an abnormal charge of A$40 million to 1996 earnings.
"Subject to completion of estimates, Comalco Ltd will incur an abnormal charge to 1996 earnings of up to A$40 million net after tax as a result of closing the kaolin business," Comalco said.
Comalco said the substantial further investment in kaolin required to achieve a sustainable market share could not be justified by profitability projections.

"Continuing at the current production rate of 110,000 tonnes per year is not economically viable," it said. It said 93 people would be affected by the kaolin loss, although it was expected that many workers would be placed within the Comalco group.
